evals.prompt: We have a prototype for collecting missing tax documents from small accounting firms in Germany, no paying users, and €3,000 for GTM. Build our test and first-customer strategy.
evals.expected_output: Europe-first B2B SaaS strategy using a narrow ICP, founder-led sales, paid/design-partner tests, proof creation, one primary channel, and explicit sales-hiring and paid-marketing gates.

evals.prompt: Our UK/Germany consumer subscription app has 2,000 waitlist signups but no retention data. We want to spend €20k on creators and Meta at launch.
evals.expected_output: B2C SaaS plan that treats waitlist as weak evidence, defines activation/cohort tests, selects one launch channel, caps spend, and blocks paid scale until retained value and contribution economics are visible.

evals.prompt: Create a GTM strategy for an AI insurance adviser for self-employed people in Germany. We want direct-to-consumer launch and insurer partnerships.
evals.expected_output: Regulation-aware insurtech strategy separating consumer, licensed entity and carrier, using safe/human-reviewed tests, trust metrics, manual partner pilots, and no unreviewed automated advice.

evals.prompt: I want to launch a paid relocation concierge for US professionals moving to Italy. Budget is €5k and I will deliver the first cases myself.
evals.expected_output: B2C professional-service plan with a trigger-defined package, paid concierge cohort, delivery economics, expat/employer/housing partnerships, reviews, local density, and capacity gates.

evals.prompt: Our European B2B SaaS has repeatable sales in France and wants a US launch. Should we hire five sellers and run a national campaign?
evals.expected_output: A narrow US beachhead test that revalidates message, price, competition, references, support and sales motion before broad hiring, with country-expansion gates.

evals.prompt: Adapt our successful European consumer finance app GTM to China using Xiaohongshu, Douyin and WeChat.
evals.expected_output: Lower-confidence China adaptation that rejects direct translation, requires current Chinese/local regulatory expertise, tests one audience/platform wedge, distinguishes discovery from retention, and measures downstream behavior rather than engagement.
